issue.title: Report page only shows transactions from early January
issue.body:
Our "FY2026 all spend" report covers January to October, but the table on its
page only shows transactions from the first couple of weeks of January, newest
first. The CSV export has all 6,400 rows. Is the page meant to show only part of
a report, and if so, which part?

comment:
label: question
file: none
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The report page is meant to show only part of a report. GET /reports/:id returns the report plus a `preview` of the first 50 matching rows (PREVIEW_ROWS in src/api/reports.ts, documented in docs/API.md). The query orders by date then id, ascending, so the preview is the earliest 50 rows, which is why it starts in early January rather than showing the newest rows. The full set is in the CSV/XLSX export, which is not capped at 50. Nothing in the code needs to change for this question; a paginated or full view would be a feature request.
